# Hyper Sonic

**Quick identification.** Hyper Sonic is a youthful yellow pegasus with a russet-orange mane and tail and green eyes. Associated with Twilight’s School of Friendship, she is best remembered for speaking up during Equestria’s final crisis when Cloudsdale’s pegasi decide to protect themselves instead of helping the ponies below.

**Name and continuity.** “Hyper Sonic” is the production-attested name listed in the Season 9 credits; it is not a reference to the Sonic the Hedgehog character. Before the finale, fans commonly called this background pony “Lemon Crumble”—a fandom-assigned name, not a separate character or a name spoken in the episode. A fan writer documented the change after the credits revealed her name: [naming-history post](https://www.fimfiction.net/blog/876048/looks-like-a-name-change-is-in-order). Fandom generally treats her as a filly, although the broadcast transcript itself does not specify gender.

**Speaking role.** Her defining speaking appearance is “The Ending of the End — Part 2” (Season 9, 2019). She asks, “What about everypony down below?” and later argues that focusing on differences keeps Equestria divided. The [episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Ending_of_the_End_-_Part_2) records both lines; the [Season 9 credits](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_nine) list Richard Ian Cox as her English voice actor (also credited as Grandpa Gruff).

**Fandom artwork.** [![CloudyGlow — Upset Lemon Crumble](https://i.imgur.com/Q8Hx0Ar.png)](https://www.teepublic.com/sticker/6510193-upset-lemon-crumble)

The fan vector is titled “Upset Lemon Crumble”; its linked artist/product page credits CloudyGlow and describes the design as Lemon Crumble from *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*.
